method: Manual editorial screening with direct-source URL and publication-date verification; quality thresholds take precedence over country targets.
rejection_policy: duplicate event or duplicate source URL
no stable direct original-article URL or publication date
sports, entertainment, lifestyle, local incident, or insufficient national policy relevance
core fact could not be corroborated to publication standard
notes: Reuters URLs may return an automated-access response while remaining canonical direct article URLs.
No item enters a causal model; news records remain descriptive event-library entries.
The existing event schema has no separate original-title, updated-at, or related-country field, so the update does not invent parallel fields.
